edges.reason: unlock() requires _previousOwner == msg.sender, so caller identity gates ownership restoration.
lock() uses now to compute _lockTime, a timestamp dependency on ownership locking.
AntiDumpMultiplier derives fee multiplier from block.timestamp - launchTimestamp.
AntSni compares block.timestamp to launchTimestamp + timeF to detect sniping.
Cooldown enforcement uses block.timestamp - _lastSell[sender] in _tokenTransfer.
launchTimestamp is initialized from block.timestamp in the constructor.
_lastSell[sender] is written with the current block.timestamp on sells.
sender address drives fee exemption, tx limit exemption and cooldown lookups.
Caller/recipient addresses flow into balanceOf during the transfer path.
_lastSell mapping is read by _tokenTransfer for cooldown verification.
_taxFee is multiplied into amounts by calculateTaxFee inside _getValues.
DevAmt = amount.mul(_DevFee).div(100) is computed in _tokenTransfer.
_liquidityFee is multiplied into amounts by calculateLiquidityFee inside _getValues.
_maxTxAmount caps non-owner transfers and clamps the contract token balance.
_setMaxbalance limits recipient balance unless isMaxbalanceExempt.
recipient == uniswapV2Pair branch enables anti-dump and sets pair exemptions.
DevAmt tokens are transferred to DevWallet at the end of _tokenTransfer.
Half of swapped ETH is sent to DevWallet with an external transfer inside _transfer.
uniswapV2Router address is the target of swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens.
uniswapV2Router is used to call addLiquidityETH.
inSwapAndLiquify guard prevents recursive swap while _transfer executes.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled gates the automatic swap branch in _transfer.
numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity is the threshold compared before swapping.
transfer delegates to _transfer with _msgSender().
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
_transfer ends by invoking _tokenTransfer with the takeFee flag.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth when contract balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer performs payable(DevWallet).transfer(half) before the token accounting completes.
_tokenTransfer selects _transferStandard for non-excluded sender and recipient.
_tokenTransfer selects _transferToExcluded when recipient is excluded.
_tokenTransfer selects _transferFromExcluded when sender is excluded.
_tokenTransfer selects _transferBothExcluded when both are excluded.
_transferStandard computes r/t values via _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the liquidity fee via _takeLiquidity.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferToExcluded computes values via _getValues.
_transferFromExcluded computes values via _getValues.
_transferBothExcluded computes values via _getValues.
swapAndLiquify swaps half the balance through swapTokensForEth.
swapAndLiquify adds token/ETH liquidity through addLiquidity.
_takeLiquidity reads the current reflection rate.
_getValues passes _getRate() into _getRValues.
_getRate derives the rate from _getCurrentSupply.
deliver computes rAmount from _getValues before burning reflections.
rSupply accumulator is initialized from _rTotal.
tSupply accumulator is initialized from _tTotal.
manualswap lets any caller trigger swapTokensForEth for an arbitrary amount.
transferForeignToken sends the measured foreign balance to DevWallet via external transfer.
manualSend pushes the whole ETH balance to DevWallet with an external transfer.
lock() writes _lockTime = now + time, a timestamp-based ownership lock.
AntiSnipedump adds the anti-dump multiplier to the liquidity fee to form the sell fee.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call flagged as unsafe.
Router swap transfers ETH to this contract (receive()), potentially re-entering the transfer flow.
AntiSnipedump calls AntiDumpMultiplier to obtain the multiplier.
AntiSnipedump calls AntSni to detect the sniping window.
excludeFromReward uses tokenFromReflection/_getRate to snapshot _tOwned.
updateTimeF (owner-only) writes the snipe window timeF.
setTaxFeePercent (owner-only) writes _taxFee.
setTxLimit (owner-only) writes _maxTxAmount.
setMaxWallet (owner-only) writes _setMaxbalance.
setDevFee (owner-only) writes _DevFee.
setSwapLimit (owner-only) writes the swap threshold.
transferOwnership (owner-only) writes _owner.
Constructor sets the deployer as _owner via Ownable.
amount is split into (amount - DevAmt) and DevAmt inside _tokenTransfer.
tAmount flows into _transferStandard's _getValues computation.
tokenAmount is approved to and swapped by the router.
ethAmount is forwarded as value to addLiquidityETH.
takeFee decides whether removeAllFee/restoreAllFee are executed.
time parameter is added to now inside lock().
selling flag selects the dynamic fee branch in AntiSnipedump.
taxFee parameter is assigned to _taxFee.
contractTokenBalance drives the swap trigger and is reused as the swap amount.
DevAmt derived from amount and _DevFee is transferred twice in the flow.
timePassed is compared against coolDownTime to allow or block the sell.
currentRate converts tLiquidity into rLiquidity credited to the contract.
rSupply is reduced by excluded account reflections.
tSupply is reduced by excluded account token balances.
time_since_start determines the returned anti-dump multiplier.
half of the contract balance is swapped for ETH.
newBalance (swapped ETH) is used as the liquidity ETH amount.
multiplier is added to the fee in AntiSnipedump.
firstFewBlocks selects the increased early-trading fee branch.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient parameter only feeds the transfer entry point.
amount parameter is consumed by the core _transfer logic.
sender parameter is only used by _tokenTransfer and its limit/cooldown checks.
to parameter belongs to the _transfer signature.
from parameter belongs to the _transfer signature.
account parameter is only used by balanceOf.
tAmount parameter flows directly into _transferStandard.
tokenAmount parameter is only used by swapTokensForEth.
ethAmount parameter is only used by addLiquidity.
takeFee flag only controls fee removal inside _tokenTransfer.
time parameter is only used by lock().
selling flag is only used by AntiSnipedump.
spender parameter is only used by approve.
taxFee parameter is only used by setTaxFeePercent.
newOwner parameter is only used by transferOwnership.
contractTokenBalance local belongs to _transfer's swap decision.
DevAmt local is computed solely inside _tokenTransfer.
timePassed local is computed solely in the _tokenTransfer cooldown check.
currentRate local is used to convert liquidity amounts in _takeLiquidity.
rSupply local exists only inside _getCurrentSupply.
tSupply local exists only inside _getCurrentSupply.
time_since_start local exists only inside AntiDumpMultiplier.
half local exists only inside swapAndLiquify.
newBalance local exists only inside swapAndLiquify.
multiplier local holds AntiDumpMultiplier output inside AntiSnipedump.
firstFewBlocks local holds AntSni output inside AntiSnipedump.
